name: Undead (baseline)
notes: Baseline for things that no longer sleep or breathe: Hollow Sentinels, the fixture sentinel, and (with overrides) the Forgotten. Darkness means nothing to them (dark vision 1.0), but their gaze is narrow (25° focus, 60° periphery, 15 m) and slow to register what it sees (detection speed 0.6), so a patient player can slip past. Hearing threshold 45 dB: they ignore quiet players and wake to clatter, shouting and breaking things (story bible §8). Life-sense feels the warmth of the living through walls, but only within 3 m and above half strength: brushing past one is dangerous, passing it at a distance is not. Forgotten who should ignore quiet players entirely override the life-sense channel with null.
